say:3:1421113001:1.source_cn: 谢、谢谢你们，多亏了你们救了我一命！

choice_prompt:4:1421113001.source_cn: 谢、谢谢你们，多亏了你们救了我一命！

say:5:1421113002:1.text: How did you find out about me? Am I famous in Sal'thorin or something？
say:5:1421113002:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，你们怎么知道？莫非我芬洛的大名已经传遍了萨洛克兰。

say:6:1421113003:1.text: So, you are Venlo. Why didn't you bring any weapons with you for the hunt?
say:6:1421113003:1.source_cn: ……原来你就是芬洛。出来打猎，怎么也不带上武器？

say:7:1421113004:1.text: I'm not the great and powerful Indris, you know. I'm just a normal commoner...
say:7:1421113004:1.source_cn: 我、我又不是因度厄那样的高手，哪敢打猎啊？！

say:8:1421113005:1.text: I was just out gathering some fuzzy mushrooms and catching some fish. Never thought I would run into mushroom sprites...
say:8:1421113005:1.source_cn: 我只是出来摘点无毒的茸茸伞菇顺便钓几条鱼，没想到就碰上...

say:9:1421113006:1.text: If I hadn't run fast enough, I'd have been eaten already...
say:9:1421113006:1.source_cn: 要不是我跑得还算快，跟它周旋了一阵子，估计前两天就被吃了……

choice_prompt:10:1421113006.text: If I hadn't run fast enough, I'd have been eaten already...
choice_prompt:10:1421113006.source_cn: 要不是我跑得还算快，跟它周旋了一阵子，估计前两天就被吃了……

say:11:1421113007:1.text: It's a sad story—I lost some and ate some while running. Now, I have to start all over again...
say:11:1421113007:1.source_cn: 唉，丢了一些，逃命的时候吃了一些，如今又得从头开始……

say:12:1421113008:1.text: Xera, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we've got to help him out!
say:12:1421113008:1.male: Xera, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we've got to help him out!
say:12:1421113008:1.female: Xera, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we've got to help him out!

say:13:1421113009:1.text: I didn't realize mushroom picking could be a life-threatening activity...
say:13:1421113009:1.source_cn: 我从来没想过，采摘最普通的蘑菇，也有可能会遭遇性命之危。

say:14:1421113010:1.text: Is this what Captain Indris' life was like in his youth, or is this what most commoners go through on a daily basis?
say:14:1421113010:1.source_cn: 这就是因度厄大人少年时的生活吗，还是大部分平民的日常呢……

say:15:1421113011:1.text: I'm afraid it's the latter. We should get a taste of the experience. I believe it could help with your writing.
say:15:1421113011:1.source_cn: 我想，应该是后者。所以，我们去体验一下吧——这样，也有...

say:16:1421113012:1.text: Let's do it! We'll start by picking the fuzzy mushrooms, then the fishing!
say:16:1421113012:1.source_cn: 就这么说定了，先去采茸茸伞菇，再去钓鱼！

say:17:1421113013:1.text: Fishing too? Are you sure about this...?
say:17:1421113013:1.source_cn: 还要钓鱼吗？那怎么好意思……

say:18:1421113014:1.text: After all, you've been stuck here for days. You need to eat.
say:18:1421113014:1.source_cn: 芬洛先生困在野外好几天了，多吃点食物准没错。

say:19:1421113015:1.text: I really appreciate it! Well... I'll just wait for you here then!
say:19:1421113015:1.source_cn: 那……那就多谢你们了！我……我先在这休息下，等你们回来！
